meta.title: About the Platform
meta.description: VireMusic is an independent music platform for artists and listeners in the CIS. Stage 1: an in-depth look at every feature — what already works and what's coming next.

hero.subtitle: VireMusic is a platform where artists publish music without middlemen, and listeners find it without algorithmic ranking games or ads. We're in an early, cozy stage right now — launching among friends and shaping the platform together with you.

examples.title: What it looks like
examples.subtitle: Live interface pieces — not screenshots.
lyrics: rain in the city, I walk without an umbrella
the streetlights seem to whisper along with me
and every step is a brand new line

player.title: Player and stream
player.text: A global player on every page: queue, scrubbing along the waveform, keyboard shortcuts (space, arrows, M, R for repeat). Sound plays as a stream — no files to download.

wave.title: Wave
wave.text: An endless stream tuned to your taste: matched by mood tags, tempo, and key. When the queue runs out, Wave keeps going on its own. You can start it from any track.

likes.title: Likes
likes.text: Like tracks from the player, a track list, or the track page — the state stays in sync everywhere and collects in your profile.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.text: Your own collections in one click: add, rename, delete. Private or link-only. You can like other people's public playlists — they show up in your library.

follows.title: Follows and feed
follows.text: Follow artists — new releases and announcements land in your personal feed.

moodTags.title: Mood tags
moodTags.text: Tracks carry mood tags — Wave runs on them, and they make it easier to find music that fits how you feel.

favoriteMoments.title: Favorite moments
favoriteMoments.text: Mark the best seconds right on the track's waveform. Marks are anonymous and build up into a shared “heat” trail.

syncedLyrics.title: Synced lyrics
syncedLyrics.text: Lyrics right in the player: lines highlight as the track plays, and tapping a line jumps playback to that spot.

sharing.title: Sharing with a timestamp
sharing.text: Share a plain link or “from M:SS” — whoever opens it lands on exactly that second.

listeningNow.title: Listening now
listeningNow.text: The track page and the artist dashboard show a live counter: how many people are listening right now.

search.title: Search
search.text: A dedicated page, a quick inline dropdown, and a command palette via ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

page.title: Page and theming
page.text: A full-bleed cover, bio, links, and video. The artist sets colors, grain, and fonts for their own page — no code changes needed.

upload.title: Uploading releases
upload.text: Upload a source file — the platform cuts it into a stream and calculates the waveform on its own. Statuses range from draft to published (scheduling included).

trackCard.title: Track card
trackCard.text: BPM, key, an explicit (18+) label, liner notes, and credits. Co-writers and their shares live at the track level.

lyrics.title: Track lyrics
lyrics.text: Add synced (LRC) or plain lyrics — listeners see them in the player, highlighted in time with the track.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Plays over 24h / 7 / 30 days, unique listeners, day-by-day trends, and repeat listens — all in the dashboard.

posts.title: Announcements
posts.text: Posts on the artist page with inline editing. Followers see them in their feed.

smartlinks.title: Smart links
smartlinks.text: Release landing pages with links to every platform — they work even without publishing the music on VireMusic itself.

whatsNext.title: What's next
whatsNext.text: Direct sales are coming: buy a track or release and support the artist directly, with no middlemen. Purchases are off in Stage 1 — we'll turn them on once everything's ready. Here's a preview of what it'll look like:

cta.title: Are you an artist?
cta.text: In Stage 1 we set up profiles by hand — tell us about yourself and share links to your music, and we'll open up access to uploading and setting up your page.
